name: Dopplesoldner
introduce:
OS-07X Dopplesoldner
One of Obsidian's high-performance light STs, developed based on the OS-06F Diana's combat data.
As a highly maneuverable execution model, it is equipped with the "Zweihander" combat core, a modification of the "Eden Core."
The balance between the limbs and torso on this ST has been carefully calibrated to maximize it's killing power.

30058.name: Kinetic Mod
30058.SpecificEffects:
Before an Active Attack in combat, for every <color=#F74848>1</color> tile moved, DMG <color=#F74848>+4.5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>18%</color>.
ST's Movement <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

20014.name: HCI System
20014.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack, there is a <color=#F74848>100%</color> chance to trigger <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.3x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.
